subject: POC trial RACI & next steps - Graystone Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@graystonehealth.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@graystonehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC recap + proposed success criteria / RACI (next steps)

Hi Sarah / Rajiv -

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and proposed plan so we have alignment before the POC kick-off:

Summary of goals
- Primary objective: Validate Redwood inference latency (95th pct) and cost per 1k tokens for Graystone's primary clinical triage model across a sample workload.
- Secondary: Validate prefix caching behavior for multi-turn workflows and check private deployment connectivity for PHI-protected datasets.

Proposed success criteria (draft)
- Latency: 95th percentile <= 300ms for 512-token requests under 5 RPS sustained load.
- Quality: model outputs match baseline human eval pass-rate >= 92% on 50-case eval set.
- Security/compliance: private VPC connection established, keys managed via customer KMS, and audit logs accessible to Graystone.
- Cost: unit cost improvement >= 20% vs current hosted baseline (per internal cost model).

Evaluation plan & timeline
- Week 0 (by Aug 17): Network/connectivity prep + install access + MSA/Procurement step.
- Week 1 (Aug 17-21): Deploy trial model, run warmup and smoke tests.
- Week 2 (Aug 24-28): Run load profile, collect latency/cost metrics, run quality evals.
- Week 3 (Aug 31-Sep 4): Review findings, identify next steps (production plan / Dedicated quote).

Ownership / RACI (draft)
- Customer infra (VPC, firewall rules): Responsible = Graystone IT (Rajiv) / Accountable = Graystone CTO (Sarah)
- App integration (API contract, sample payloads): Responsible = Graystone Eng (internal), Consulted = Aditya Rao
- Security & compliance (KMS, SOC2 evidence): Responsible = Redwood SecOps (Dev Patel), Consulted = Graystone security
- Procurement & contracts: Responsible = Graystone procurement, Accountable = Graystone legal
- Redwood config/deployment: Responsible = Redwood (Marissa / Aditya), Accountable = Marissa

Immediate next steps
1) Sarah / Rajiv: confirm the proposed success criteria and timeline (reply by EOD Wed Aug 12).
2) Rajiv / Graystone IT: share a shortlist of IPs and egress rules we should allow (network_requirements.xlsx attached).
3) Marissa: loop in Dev Patel and Security to get SOC2/KMS checklist ready.
4) Procurement: if possible, start MSA review - we sent Mutual Action Plan (attached) in the call.

Attachments: POC_Success_Criteria_Graystone_v1.pdf, network_requirements.xlsx, Mutual_Action_Plan_Graystone_RevA.docx

Looking forward - I can host a 30-min kickoff on Monday Aug 17 if that works.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0136

Marissa - thanks for the clear recap. Quick confirmations and asks: 

- Success criteria look good to us; the latency target is aggressive but reasonable for our sample.
- SOC2 Type II: we need to see the certification and where logs/audit exports live. Can Dev/Redwood SecOps provide evidence and the KMS integration plan by Aug 14?

I'll loop our procurement and security leads here (procurement@graystonehealth.com). We can target Aug 17 for kickoff, pending procurement sign-off.

Folks - forwarding Graystone thread. Two asks from Rajiv above: SOC2 evidence + KMS plan by Aug 14, and a short network checklist for their infra team.

Aditya: can you own the deployment checklist, sample payloads, and the perf-run plan? Please produce the load profile (5 RPS sustain) and a quick runbook we can hand to Rajiv's team.

Dev: can you own SOC2 evidence, KMS integration checklist, and provide answers about audit log exports (where we store, retention, access controls)? If possible, drop a 1-page security checklist and approximate time for us to enable customer-managed KMS in a private deployment. Attach raci-stakeholder-mapping.csv with the draft RACI (I updated the accountable/responsible columns).

Targets:
- Aditya: share deployment/runbook by Thu Aug 13 EOD
- Dev: share SOC2 summary + KMS plan by Thu Aug 13 EOD
- Marissa: confirm kickoff scheduled for Mon Aug 17 10:00am PT if Graystone is good

Thanks -
Marissa
